name: aiprepkit
description: Turns a job description into a personalised interview preparation kit.

scripts.evaluate: npm run build -w @aiprepkit/core && npm run evaluate -w @aiprepkit/backend --
scripts.build: npm run build -w @aiprepkit/core && npm run build -w @aiprepkit/backend && npm run build -w @aiprepkit/frontend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build -w @aiprepkit/core && npm run build -w @aiprepkit/backend
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build -w @aiprepkit/core && npm run build -w @aiprepkit/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @aiprepkit/core && npm run test -w @aiprepkit/backend
